children: laid out an ambitious financial roadmap through 2030, targeting more than $10 billion in free cash flow as it looks to build a larger, more profitable entertainment business following its combination with Warner Bros.

The company expects total revenue to grow at a mid-single-digit annual rate from 2026 through 2030, while targeting an adjusted EBITDA margin in the mid-20% range by 2030. It also expects free-cash-flow conversion to reach about 50%.

is targeting at least $6 billion in run-rate synergies within three years, with 30% expected to be realized in the first year and 70% in the second. The company plans to shift the meaningful majority of its revenue and profits toward its direct-to-consumer and studios businesses by 2030.
also outlined a deleveraging path, targeting net leverage of 3.75 times in 2028 and 3 times in 2029 as it works toward investment-grade credit metrics.
Capital allocation will initially focus on organic investment and balance-sheet improvement. Once investment-grade metrics are reached, Skydance
said it will consider additional ways to return value to shareholders.

title: Skydance targets more than $10B of free cash flow by 2030
